title: Communion of the Holy Spirit
definition: Communion of the Holy Spirit is the fellowship believers share with God and one another through the Spirit's presence and work.
summary: The Spirit brings believers into fellowship with God and the body of Christ.
christFocus: Jesus gives the Spirit so His people may live in fellowship with God and one another.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The communion of the Holy Spirit refers to shared fellowship produced by His presence. Believers are brought near to God and joined together as one body.

This communion is not merely emotional closeness. It is grounded in the Gospel, shaped by truth, and expressed in love, unity, worship, and mutual care.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Isolation and division weaken believers and churches. This doctrine matters because Christian life is shared life in God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pursue fellowship that honors the Spirit. Practice love, unity, prayer, worship, and care within the body of Christ.
